name: Offline Translate
author: Lekonidus
description: Translate ~115 languages to English, fully offline (NLLB-200); copying non-English text shows a translation popup. INSTALL: run `omarchy plugin add https://github.com/Lekonidus/omarchy-offline-translate.git --enable`, then click the translate icon in the bar and choose "Run setup" (one-time 1.4 GB download).

barWidget.description: Open the translator; shows when the model is loaded
